pli-tv-pvr16:25.1: kaṭhinaṃ jānitabbaṃ, kaṭhinatthāro jānitabbo, kaṭhinassa atthāramāso jānitabbo, kaṭhinassa atthāravipatti jānitabbā, kaṭhinassa atthārasampatti jānitabbā, nimittakammaṃ jānitabbaṃ, parikathā jānitabbā, kukkukataṃ jānitabbaṃ, sannidhi jānitabbā, nissaggiyaṃ jānitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr16:26.2: tesañ ñeva dhammānaṃ saṃgaho samavāyo nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo yad idaṃ kaṭhinan ti.
pli-tv-pvr16:30.2: nimittaṃ karoti iminā dussena kaṭhinaṃ attharissāmīti.
pli-tv-pvr16:31.2: parikathaṃ karoti imāya parikathāya kaṭhinadussaṃ nibbattessāmīti.
pli-tv-pvr16:33.2: dve sannidhiyo jānitabbā karaṇasannidhi ca nicayasannidhi ca.
pli-tv-pvr16:35.2: sace saṃghassa kaṭhinadussaṃ uppannaṃ hoti saṃghena kathaṃ paṭipajjitabbaṃ, atthārakena kathaṃ paṭipajjitabbaṃ, anumodakena kathaṃ paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.1: saṃghena ñattidutiyena kammena kaṭhinatthārakassa bhikkhuno dātabbaṃ. tena kaṭhinatthārakena bhikkhunā tadah' eva dhovitvā vimajjitvā vicāretvā chinditvā sibbetvā rajitvā kappaṃ katvā kaṭhinaṃ attharitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.2: sace saṃghāṭiyā kaṭhinaṃ attharitukāmo hoti porāṇikā saṃghāṭi paccuddharitabbā, navā saṃghāṭi adhiṭṭhātabbā,
pli-tv-pvr16:36.3: imāya saṃghāṭiyā kaṭhinaṃ attharāmīti vācā bhinditabbā.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.4: sace uttarāsaṅgena kaṭhinaṃ attharitukāmo hoti porāṇako uttarāsaṅgo paccuddharitabbo, navo uttarāsaṅgo adhiṭṭhātabbo,
pli-tv-pvr16:36.5: iminā uttarāsaṅgena kaṭhinaṃ attharāmīti vācā bhinditabbā.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.6: sace antaravāsakena kaṭhinaṃ attharitukāmo hoti porāṇako antaravāsako paccuddharitabbo, navo antaravāsako adhiṭṭhātabbo,
pli-tv-pvr16:36.7: iminā antaravāsakena kaṭhinaṃ attharāmīti vācā bhinditabbā.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.8: tena kaṭhinatthārakena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-pvr16:36.9: atthataṃ bhante saṃghassa kaṭhinaṃ, dhammiko kaṭhinatthāro, anumodathā 'ti.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.10: tehi anumodakehi bhikkhūhi ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-pvr16:36.11: atthataṃ āvuso saṃghassa kaṭhinaṃ, dhammiko kaṭhinatthāro, anumodāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.12: tena kaṭhinatthārakena bhikkhunā sambahule bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-pvr16:36.16: tena kaṭhinatthārakena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-pvr16:36.17: atthataṃ āvuso saṃghassa kaṭhinaṃ, dhammiko kaṭhinatthāro, anumodāhīti.
pli-tv-pvr16:36.18: tena anumodakena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-pvr16:36.19: atthataṃ āvuso saṃghassa kaṭhinaṃ, dhammiko kaṭhinatthāro, anumodāmīti. ||4|| saṃgho
